prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: single finished wide landscape product-card artwork for Shop Status, a Discord bot feature that opens or closes a shop and announces the current status to a Discord channel.
Input image: supplied Review Credit artwork is a STYLE AND CHARACTER REFERENCE ONLY. Match the exact same friendly white ceramic floating bot head, obsidian glass face and glowing blurple square eyes, circular lavender glass platform, prominent white Discord Clyde emblem on round blurple badge centered on front of platform, soft pearl-white studio, camera angle, materials, scale and polished lighting. Replace ALL review-related objects with Shop Status imagery.
Primary request: a beautiful premium 3D artwork that immediately communicates Discord bot shop open/close control, with NO written text.
Subject: the familiar cute floating bot head sits center-right above the lavender glass platform. Center-left, next to the bot, one beautifully designed miniature storefront: white ceramic structure, sophisticated alternating pearl-white and Discord-blurple striped scalloped awning, softly glowing warm interior, a simple open doorway with the door slightly ajar. Keep its architecture compact and unmistakably a shop, with no sign lettering. A tiny silver hanging status placard next to its door contains ONLY a luminous green circular indicator, no lettering. In front of the shop is one elegant sculptural physical toggle switch on a compact pill-shaped frosted glass base. Switch knob is slid to the right with mint-green illuminated track, communicating shop ON / open without any labels. On its left end a small dim coral indicator hints at the alternative closed state, secondary to green. Above the storefront floats one small simple white ceramic announcement bell with a delicate lavender halo, representing status announcements. Keep the bell understated and visually secondary.
Composition: balanced unified central still life, shop center-left and bot center-right equally readable; physical toggle in front of shop, all arranged above one shared circular lavender glass plinth. Correct recognizable Discord Clyde logo on blurple enamel medallion on the plinth front; two round eye cutouts. One tiny green connected status light beside badge. Leave generous margins, full bot, shop and plinth visible, quiet upper-left corner for website overlay. Landscape 16:9 about 1672x941 or higher, no text column.
Style/medium: exceptionally polished luxury CGI product illustration. Porcelain white ceramic, satin Discord blurple #5865F2, softly brushed silver, precise refractive lavender glass. Realistic subtle material textures, controlled specular highlights, wide softbox key from upper left, gentle purple-blue rim light, warm interior glow, delicate ray-traced shadows. Airy seamless near-white to pale lavender studio, soft reflective matte floor. White, silver, blurple, lavender with small green and warm amber accents. Clear thumbnail-readable silhouette, premium clean art direction.
Constraints: one bot, one storefront, one physical toggle, one small bell, one platform and Discord emblem. Absolutely NO letters, words, text, numbers, labels, price tags, OPEN/CLOSED signage, UI screenshots, watermark or outer card frame. No review bubbles, hearts, stars, coins, wallet, headphones, server hardware, people, hands or robot limbs. Avoid clutter, excessive neon, charts and any additional gadgets. Render finished artwork itself, not a website mockup.
